findings.claim: The Redis store ttl is 600 seconds and the cookie sets no maxAge, so connect-redis falls back to the store ttl and sessions expire after 10 minutes without a request. SESSION_TTL_SECONDS (24h) is never used.
findings.would_refute: A cookie maxAge or expires being set, or Redis keys showing a 24h TTL

findings.claim: app.set('trust proxy') is never called in src/server.ts, so with cookie secure: true behind the TLS-terminating load balancer the session cookie is dropped.
findings.would_refute: A trust proxy setting anywhere in the app bootstrap

findings.claim: The session config sets rolling: true, so the cookie is re-issued on every response.
